_description: PR-scoped CodeQL alerts newly raised by GitHub's re-analysis of PR #108's head AFTER the PR #102/Wave 27 main-branch merge (git merge origin/main -> security/codeql-repowide-closure). These 10 alerts (#1028-#1037) are NOT part of, and must not be folded into, the 171-alert repository-wide baseline recorded in codeql_main_alert_inventory.json -- that baseline was established and fully dispositioned (35 REAL_VULNERABILITY fixed, 136 SAFE_BUT_CODEQL_BLIND/TEST_ONLY_FALSE_POSITIVE, 0 NEEDS_REVIEW) before the Wave 27 merge. This file tracks only this second, smaller, PR-scoped batch discovered by GitHub's automated re-scan of the merged head, kept in a separate file specifically so the two counts are never conflated in reporting.
discovered: 2026-09-01, after merging origin/main (PR #102/Wave 27, config-domain closure) into security/codeql-repowide-closure

alerts.notes: Flagged line is cleanup_import_review_files()'s already-fixed except BeetsError handler: ex is logged server-side via app.logger.warning, only a fixed literal string is returned to the client. Proven by test_cleanup_import_review_files_beets_error_is_sanitized (asserts no leak marker in response). CodeQL is tracking ex's flow into the intentional server-side log call, not into the response.

Original fix (this session, pre-Wave-27) bounded only the delimiter-content quantifier ([^)\]]{1,100}) and left the leading \s* unbounded. Empirically proven still quadratic (~5.4s @ 32,000 chars) against a 'long whitespace run + one unclosed bracket' adversarial shape not covered by the original test suite. Fixed by also bounding leading whitespace to \s{0,20}. Covered by test_playlist_title_variants_is_not_quadratic_long_leading_whitespace.
Same incomplete-bound issue and same fix as #1029 (\s{0,20} added ahead of the bracket). Covered by test_playlist_strip_artist_channel_noise_is_not_quadratic_long_leading_whitespace.

Same incomplete-bound issue and same fix as #1029 (\s{0,20} added ahead of the parenthesis). Covered by test_playlist_artist_name_variants_is_not_quadratic_long_leading_whitespace. A previously-unreported sibling pattern (_JUNK_RE, inside playlist_parse()'s yt-dlp branch) had the identical gap and was proactively fixed the same way even though CodeQL had not (yet) flagged it separately.

Flagged line is this function's own containment gate (_path_is_under against MUSIC_ROOT/DOWNLOADS_ROOT) added by this PR. Local rglob() scan only runs after this check passes; otherwise falls through to engine-side inspect_import_source().
Flagged line is this function's own containment gate, reusing the same pattern as _folder_import_track_count, added by this PR.

Flagged line is the validator's own body (resolve(strict=False) then containment check) added by this PR to fix the /api/import cluster's arbitrary directory creation/enumeration bug. CodeQL flags the validator's own resolve() call, not a downstream use of unvalidated input.
Same validator-flags-itself pattern as #1034, added by this PR to fix /api/dedup/scan.

Flagged line is the post-containment existence probe (root_res.exists()/is_dir()), reached only after the containment check on the preceding line passes -- the fix for the existence-oracle-before-containment ordering bug this PR closed.
Second CodeQL dataflow path to the same post-containment existence probe as #1036; same disposition and rationale.
